meta.title: Skep — Cross-device collaboration for AI coding agents
meta.description: Cross-device collaboration for AI coding agents via live join-code sessions. Open source CLI @skepagent/skep v0.1.14. Credentials never leave your device.
hero.title: Your agents, on every device, in one live session.
hero.lead: Cross-device collaboration for AI coding agents via live join-code sessions.

qs.title: Up in three steps
qs.sub: Run Skep inside any git repository.
qs.s1.title: Start a session
qs.s1.body: On the master device, open a session. You get a join code and an address.
qs.s2.title: Join from another device
qs.s2.body: In the peer's TUI, run {0} with the code and address. Any repo checkout works.
qs.s3.title: Hand out the work
qs.s3.body: Let the orchestrator split it ({0}, {1}, {2}, {3}), or send an intent yourself.

sec.title: Credentials never leave your device
sec.body: Each device runs its agent with its own login. Provider keys and tokens are never sent over the session, and a peer only shares output if you opt in.
